verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.

xrefs.text: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil— how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

verses.text: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

xrefs.text: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

verses.text: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

xrefs.text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.

verses.text: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.

xrefs.text: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

verses.text: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.

xrefs.text: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You— majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!

verses.text: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.

xrefs.text: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.

“What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.

verses.text: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:

xrefs.text: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.
You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

verses.text: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”

xrefs.text: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.

verses.text: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.

xrefs.text: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.

verses.text: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

xrefs.text: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
I did not shrink back from declaring anything that was helpful to you as I taught you publicly and from house to house,
This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
For my eyes have seen Your salvation,

verses.text: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.

xrefs.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.

verses.text: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

xrefs.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

verses.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.

xrefs.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
Then Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.
But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

verses.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

xrefs.text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
Surely they will say of Me, ‘In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.’” All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.
When Jesus said, “I am He, they drew back and fell to the ground.
May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.

verses.text: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.

xrefs.text: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.

verses.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”

xrefs.text: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
This became known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, and fear came over all of them. So the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!

verses.text: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

xrefs.text: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
